## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (91%)** · Confident · Read in turn

Conformal set is Normal only, and every agreement check matches [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 91%, Benign 9% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | Normal only (α=0.1) | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 42nd percentile | Typical, usable input |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Models agree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal [F5] | Unanimous neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · scarce, below typical; lowers invasive association [F2] · Validated
- **Normal lobules, two-layered epithelium** (regions 2, 9) · ↓ invasive · above typical; linked to non-invasive tissue [F3] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 6, 7) · ↓ invasive · prominent; linked to lower invasive likelihood [F4] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined in ducts** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · scarce; absence slightly raises concept-model score · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Concept deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007), so not shown to reflect the classifier; lobules concept is Unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated blur (severity 3) hides nuclear detail the model needs.
- Reliability ranks errors only modestly (AUROC 0.69), so 0.99 is weak reassurance.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 0**: confirm the stroma shows no tumor infiltration.
2. **Regions 2, 9**: verify true lobules; this concept failed its spot check.
3. **Regions 1, 6, 7**: confirm glands are benign architecture, not neoplastic tubules.
